scripts.test:a11y: echo 'No separate a11y suite: the axe-core checks run inside the Playwright suite (yarn test:e2e), which needs browsers and a running app. Present because YarnBuilder.test() invokes it and fails the Jenkins test stage on a missing script — see docs/PIPELINES.md.'
scripts.test:gazette: yarn workspace e2e-tests exec playwright test --config playwright.gazette.config.ts
scripts.test:document-viewer: yarn workspace e2e-tests exec playwright test --config playwright.document-viewer.config.ts
scripts.test:session: yarn workspace e2e-tests exec playwright test --config playwright.session.config.ts
scripts.test:functional: echo 'No functional suite: every journey spec needs a caseworker signed in through the local rse-idam-simulator and the in-memory deed-poll-api mock on :3200, neither of which a deployed environment has, so the deployed subset is test:smoke. Present because sectionDeployToAKS invokes it on aat AND preview — every PR — and fails the deploy on a missing script. See docs/PIPELINES.md.'
scripts.build:app: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.assets.json && vite build --config vite.build.ts --configLoader runner
scripts.clean: find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete && rm -rf dist && find libs -name node_modules -prune -o -name dist -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.dev: yarn dev:up && turbo watch dev dev:app
scripts.dev:nowatch: yarn dev:up && yarn mock:api & yarn dev:nowatch:web
scripts.dev:nowatch:web: yarn dev:up && yarn build:app:dev && NODE_ENV=development ENVIRONMENT_NAME=development PERSONA_SWITCHER_ENABLED=true VITE_MIDDLEWARE=false tsx src/server.ts
